name: theme
description: The app's theme: (theme, and theme/chrome without Web Awesome's native styles) Web Awesome set up with its --wa-* design tokens retoned for the brand, following the system's light/dark mode, (theme/vscode) mapped onto the active VS Code color theme in the workbench document, (theme/components/*) the Web Awesome components the app may use, the only way in to them, (theme/recipes, theme/app-window) the app's shapes and composed components, published from components/, and (theme/styles/*) each surface's own styles, all Stitches (PLAN.md).
